newsitem.title: FRANCE: France expels Romanian illegal immigrants.
newsitem.headline: France expels Romanian illegal immigrants.

text.p: France on Thursday expelled 29 Romanian illegal immigrants, including 10 who had just completed jail terms here, the Interior Ministry said.
The special charter flight carrying the Romanians home was the 35th of its kind since the Interior Minister Jean-Louis Debre took office in mid-1995.
Most flights have been to Romania and West and Central Africa.
A ministry statement said more than 23,000 foreigners who had entered France illegally or remained after their visas had run out had been expelled in the period, most of them by land or sea.
Nearly 1,300 people who helped them cross into France or hid them were arrested as were an equal number who specialised in hiring illegals, nearly always at rates below legal minimum wage levels.
Immigration is a major issue in France where unemployment is close to 13 percent. There are about four million foreigners in France legally and an estimated one million here illegally.
